observations.observation: The useful Portuguese fact scored 0.6 but was abstained because the current min_confidence is 0.7, causing a missing memory.
The subsequent query returned null instead of the expected Portuguese because the fact was not stored.
A clearly unwanted orange fact scored 0.3 and was correctly abstained at the current threshold, providing evidence that lowering the threshold only to 0.6 preserves this abstention.

hypothesis: Lowering min_confidence from 0.7 to 0.6 will admit the useful Portuguese fact while continuing to reject the 0.3-confidence unwanted fact, improving complete-scenario success without changing retrieval isolation or filtering.
predicted_effect: The useful-low-confidence scenario should return Portuguese instead of null. Clean abstention should remain unchanged, with no expected hard-constraint impact; storage may increase only for the newly admitted useful fact.
